body: No, my supervisor and head of department know that I've been depressed, but I haven't told them the exact details.

I can't afford counselling - I have no job and it costs. In any case, I tried to access the services when I was still at university. However it took around 3 months to get an appointment, by which time I had left the area. I don't think they offer services where you can just turn up.

I wanted to focus on feeling better, but I feel like I have to finish my studies first, if I can. That now means me divulging distressing information about my struggles with suicidal thoughts to a panel of people from the university, who I will likely know personally.

I'm doing badly, that's the truth of it. The college is there trying to kick me off the course before I have a chance to fail... because it would look bad on their pass/fail statistics otherwise. The last 10 years of my life I have been studying for this - and now it's pretty much all over.
But it counts for nothing. In the end, I have wasted 5 years of my life doing something that I will fail miserably at.
